name: hivemind-vscode
displayName: Hivemind: team memory for AI coding agents
description: Your team's lessons and locked rules, inside the editor: CodeLens, hovers, squiggles with quick fixes, ghost text that follows the team's lessons, and collision warnings when another agent is editing your file.

commands.title: Check this file against team rules
Teach Hivemind a lesson from the selection

hivemind.apiUrl.markdownDescription: Hivemind server (the web app). Falls back to `HIVEMIND_API_URL` from the environment when left at the default.

hivemind.token.markdownDescription: Bearer token (`HIVEMIND_TOKEN`). Falls back to the `HIVEMIND_TOKEN` environment variable.

hivemind.user.markdownDescription: Your Hivemind person id, e.g. `alex`. Falls back to `HIVEMIND_USER`, then your OS user name.

hivemind.repo.markdownDescription: Repo scope, e.g. `repo/export-service`. Default: `repo/<workspace folder name>`.

hivemind.dashboardUrl.markdownDescription: Web app URL for *Open dashboard*. Default: the API URL.

hivemind.inlineSuggestions.markdownDescription: Ghost-text suggestions that follow the team's lessons (when you open a new function in a file that has rules).

hivemind.checkOnType.markdownDescription: Check the file against team rules while you type (debounced). It always runs on open and save.

hivemind.collisionWarnings.markdownDescription: Warn when another person's agent edited an open file in the last 10 minutes.

hivemind.shareActivity.markdownDescription: Tell Hivemind when you save a file, so other agents get a collision warning.
